recipes.title: Air Fryer Steak Straight from Frozen

items.i: frozen steak (about 10 oz / 280 g, e.g. ribeye or sirloin)

steps: Rub the frozen steak (no thawing) with avocado oil.
Season the top with salt, pepper and garlic powder, flip, season the other side, and air fry 8 minutes more.
Check the temperature; flip and cook about 5 more minutes, or until it reaches your preferred doneness (130–135°F / 54–57°C for medium-rare).
Top with garlic herb butter, tent with foil and rest 5–10 minutes before slicing.
recipes.notes: Times are from the video (about 21 minutes total for his steak); thicker steaks need longer, so go by internal temperature. Steak size and macros are estimates.
